research.title: Evidence Sensitivity in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Designed controlled experiments varying passage relevance and evidence ordering to assess answer grounding in retrieval-augmented question answering.
Analyzed unsupported answers and citation mismatches across retrieval conditions, separating evidence selection errors from failures to use relevant context.

research.title: Cross-Domain Robustness of Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Designed transfer experiments comparing supervised fine-tuning and continued pretraining for entity recognition across news and technical documents.
Analyzed entity boundary and type errors by terminology overlap, annotation consistency, and sentence length to characterize domain transfer behavior.

research.title: Support Request Classification Under Label Imbalance
bullets: Designed experiments comparing class weighting and resampling for support request classification using sparse text features and pretrained sentence representations.
Analyzed per-category precision, recall, and confusion patterns, examining how ambiguous requests and overlapping category definitions affected classification errors.

publications.title: Class Weighting and Resampling for Imbalanced Support Request Classification

work.title: Text Import Validation and Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for imported text records, handling missing fields, inconsistent encodings, and duplicate identifiers before downstream processing.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and investigated processing failures using application logs, documenting reproduction steps and verified fixes.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sentence Similarity Models
bullets: Implemented lexical overlap, term frequency weighting, and pretrained embedding baselines for ranking sentence pairs by semantic similarity.
Compared rank correlations against reference judgments and examined disagreements involving negation, word order changes, and shared vocabulary without shared meaning.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Redundancy Control
bullets: Implemented sentence scoring with centroid similarity and graph ranking, adding a standard redundancy penalty during summary selection.
Compared summaries under matched length constraints using reference overlap and manual checks for repetition, missing context, and sentence coherence.

projects.title: Confidence Calibration for Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented logistic regression and a pretrained text classifier for sentiment prediction, applying temperature scaling to held-out validation scores.
Compared calibration error and selective prediction behavior, inspecting confidence distributions for mixed sentiment, negation, and unfamiliar product terminology.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for Document Search
bullets: Implemented lexical retrieval and sentence embedding search over document passages, using identical query sets and relevance judgments for comparison.
Evaluated ranking quality across passage lengths and query formulations, analyzing cases involving exact terminology, paraphrases, and underspecified information needs.
